summary: Iteration 13 — FASE 1 (Anagrafica azienda + PDF DDT/Fatture + DDT edit + first-run wizard). Backend 11/11 pytest PASS, frontend flows all green.
verified_features: GET /api/company returns empty skeleton with setup_complete=false for empty tenant
PUT /api/company full 6 required fields (nome/ragione_sociale/partita_iva/indirizzo/email/telefono) -> setup_complete=true; persisted via GET
PATCH /api/ddt/{id} (non_fatturato) recomputes imponibile with listino pricing
Frontend first-run: admin login with empty company auto-redirects to /azienda?first=1 with 'Benvenuto in CleanTec!' banner
Frontend form shows * on required fields; Save button displays 'Compila 6 campi' (disabled) until all required filled, then switches to 'Salva anagrafica'
After Save with all required -> redirect to /dashboard
Subsequent logins (setup_complete=true) no longer redirect to wizard; /azienda shows 'Configurazione completa' badge
DDT list: 'Scarica PDF' button on every row; 'Modifica' pencil + delete buttons only on Non fatturato rows
DDT Edit modal opens precompilato (Cliente, Righe, Note) with 'Aggiorna DDT' button
Fatture list: PDF button on every row
Sidebar: 'Anagrafica azienda' (Buildings icon) visible for admin role
critical_code_review_comments: pdf_service._logo_flowable silently swallows exceptions (bare except). Consider logging to aid troubleshooting malformed logos.
company.py: PUT uses exclude_unset=False so any missing optional key resets to empty string. Acceptable for the full-form UX but worth documenting.
company.py logo upload: tenant logo files not pruned on re-upload (old path overwritten in doc but object remains in storage). Minor storage leak; low-priority.
ddt PATCH: when body.righe omitted, imponibile not recalculated (correct). When provided but empty list, becomes 0 — consider min_items=1 validation.
seed_data_creation: Test left DEMO company configured: nome=CleanTec Test, partita_iva=IT99999999999, etc. No DB cleanup required (singleton per-tenant). DDT-2026-00020 patched with note='TEST_patched' (qty +1 on riga[0]).
context_for_next_testing_agent: FASE 1 complete & verified. Company anagrafica singleton per-tenant, logo tenant-scoped behind auth. PDF endpoints produce valid %PDF-1.4 bytes. DDT PATCH blocks fatturato (409). First-run wizard intercepts at Layout.jsx useEffect. Next phases: (2) offerte/contratti, (3) portale cliente con token.
